newsitem.title: USA: AK Steel chairman comfortable with estimates.
newsitem.headline: AK Steel chairman comfortable with estimates.

text.p: AK Steel Holding Corp Chairman Thomas Graham said Monday he was comfortable with analysts' estimates for the third quarter and the full year.
Wall Street's consensus estimate for the third quarter is $1.26 per share and for the full year is $5.06 per share.
In last year's third quarter the company posted earnings of $2.02 per share. For the full year, AK Steel posted earnings of $8.14 per share.
AK Steel, based in Middletown, Ohio, is expected to report third-quarter results the week of October 7. The company is the sixth-largest U.S. integrated steelmaker.
"The analysts have us down (in the third quarter from a year ago) and we have said we're satisfied with that outlook," Graham told Reuters.

Industry analysts are expecting earnings at many steel companies to fall in the third quarter from a year ago, chiefly because prices in supply contracts with large customers including automakers have softened this year from 1995.
